<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include">
    <sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE">
        <access>package_private</access>
        <active>true</active>
        <api_name>sn_rm_ws.RMWorkspaceDataFetchSNC</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>false</client_callable>
        <description>this is responsible to fetch the top and bottom grid data</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>RMWorkspaceDataFetchSNC</name>
        <sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var RMWorkspaceDataFetchSNC = Class.create();
RMWorkspaceDataFetchSNC.prototype = {
    initialize: function(timeSpan, effortType) {
        this.ALLOCATION = 'allocation';
        this.OPERATIONAL_WORK = 'operational_work';
        this.RESOURCE_PLAN = 'resource_plan';
        this.PENDING_STATE = 'pending';
        this.APPROVED_STATE = 'approved';
        this.UNAPPROVED_STATE = 'unapproved';
        this.DISPLAY_PENDING_STATE = gs.getMessage('Pending');
        this.RESOURCE_ASSIGNMENT = 'sn_plng_att_core_resource_assignment';
        this.timeSpan = timeSpan || RMWorkspaceConstants.WEEKLY_TIMESPAN;
        this.effortType = effortType || 'hours';
        this.topTaskMap = {};
        this.resAllocEffortFieldMap = {
            hours: 'allocated_hours',
            fte: 'requested_fte',
            man_days: 'requested_man_days'
        };
        this.effortSuffixMap = {
            hours: gs.getMessage('Hours'),
            allocated_hours: gs.getMessage('Hours'),
            requested_hours: gs.getMessage('Hours'),
            requested_fte: gs.getMessage('FTE'),
            fte: gs.getMessage('FTE'),
            requested_man_days: gs.getMessage('Person days'),
            man_days: gs.getMessage('Person days')
        };

        this.addTrendFirstDayOfWeek = gs.getProperty('glide.ui.date_format.first_day_of_week', RMWorkspaceConstants.DEFAULT_UI_DATE_FORMAT_FIRST_DAY_OF_WEEK);
        this.resourceMap = {};
        this.userCapacityAggregateObj = {};
        this.resourcePlanDateMap = {};
        this.decimalSeparator = GlideLocale.get().getDecimalSeparator();
        this.excludedWorkTypes = gs.getProperty("com.snc.resource_management.exclude_events_from_schedule");
        this.avatharSrc = {};
        this.readAccessCheckEnabled = new sn_plng_att_core.PlanningAttributeHelper().isReadAccessCheckEnabled() || false;
    },

    /**
     * this should return the array of row objects for grid
     */
    getData(columns, startDate, endDate, userList, isTopGrid = true, firstRow, filterCriteria = '', filterTable, filterType) {
        const empIds = this.createResourceRow(userList);
		if(filterType == 'report_view'){
			filterCriteria = this._alterCriteriaBasedOnAsmtIds(filterTable, filterCriteria);
		}
        const asgnmtData = this.getAssignmentData(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds, isTopGrid, firstRow, filterCriteria);
        const resBoardStatusMap = this._getResBoardStatusMap(columns);
        const asmts = asgnmtData.asmts;
        const resourceBoardStatus = (asgnmtData.resourceBoardStatus === this.DISPLAY_PENDING_STATE) ? resBoardStatusMap.pending.displayValue : asgnmtData.resourceBoardStatus;
        const allocs = (isTopGrid) ? this.getClassicResourcePlanAllocations(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds) : [];
        const resRows = this._getResourceRows();
        const gridRowData = resRows.concat(asmts, allocs);
        return {
            gridRowData,
            resourceBoardStatus,
            resBoardStatusMap
        };
    },

	_alterCriteriaBasedOnAsmtIds(filterTable, filterCriteria) {
		var asmtIds = [];
		const columnName = new sn_plng_att_core.RMDashboardHelper().getAsmtFieldFromTable(filterTable);
		if(!columnName)
			return null;
		var gr = new GlideAggregate(filterTable);
		gr.addEncodedQuery(filterCriteria);
		gr.groupBy(columnName);
		gr.query();
		while(gr.next()){
			asmtIds.push(gr.getValue(columnName));
		}

		return 'sys_idIN'+asmtIds.join(',');
	},

    _getResBoardStatusMap(columns) {
        let statusValues = {};
        for (const col of columns) {
            if (col.name == "resource_status") {
                statusValues = col.meta_data.status_value_map;
                break;
            }
        }
        return statusValues;
    },
    _getUserCapacityAggregateData(table, dateCol, dates, empIds) {
        const resourceAggregateGr = new GlideAggregate(table);
        resourceAggregateGr.addQuery('category', 'IN', 'capacity');
        resourceAggregateGr.addQuery('user', 'IN', empIds.join(','));
        resourceAggregateGr.addQuery(dateCol, ">=", dates.startDate);
        resourceAggregateGr.addQuery(dateCol, "<=", dates.endDate);
        resourceAggregateGr.addQuery('hours', '>', 0);
        resourceAggregateGr.query();
        while (resourceAggregateGr.next()) {
            const userId = resourceAggregateGr.getValue('user');
            const date = resourceAggregateGr.getValue(dateCol);
            const hours = resourceAggregateGr.getValue('hours');
            if (!(userId in this.userCapacityAggregateObj))
                this.userCapacityAggregateObj[userId] = {};
            if (!(date in this.userCapacityAggregateObj[userId]))
                this.userCapacityAggregateObj[userId][date] = 0;
            this.userCapacityAggregateObj[userId][date] += hours;
        }
    },

    createResourceRow(userList,filterType) {
        const empIds = [], userRows = [];
        for (const user in userList) {
            const id = userList[user].id;
            resRowObj = {
                id: id,
                task: {
                    value: userList[user].id,
                    displayValue: userList[user].userName,
                    indicator: {
                        icon: "circle-check-outline",
                        "color": "--now-color_alert--positive-2",
                        "tooltip": gs.getMessage("Resource is properly allocated based on their schedule through this specific time period.")
                    },
                    group_resource: userList[user].primary_resource_group,
                    role: userList[user].primary_resource_role,
                    skill: userList[user].primary_resource_skill
                },
                _metadata: {
                    disableRowReorder: true,
                    disableRowContextMenu: true,
                    disableEditing: true,
                }
            };
			userRows.push(resRowObj);
            empIds.push(id);
            this.resourceMap[id] = resRowObj;
        }
         return (filterType!='task')?empIds: userRows;
    },

    getEmpProfilesForFilter(filterCriteria, limit, filterType, filterTable) {
        return this._getEmpProfiles(filterCriteria, limit, filterType, filterTable);
    },

    getAssignmentData(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds, isTopGrid = true, firstRow, filterCriteria) {
	this.getAttributesColumnsOnResourceAssignment();
        const asmts = [];
        const asmtGr = new GlideRecord('sn_plng_att_core_resource_assignment');
        asmtGr.addQuery('start_date', '<=', endDate);
        asmtGr.addQuery('end_date', '>=', startDate);
        if (filterCriteria)
            asmtGr.addEncodedQuery(filterCriteria);
        if (isTopGrid) {
            asmtGr.addNotNullQuery('user_resource');
            asmtGr.addQuery('user_resource', 'IN', empIds);
        } else {
            asmtGr.addNullQuery('user_resource');
            asmtGr.addQuery('assignment_type', 'user');
            const assignmentBatchSize = RMWorkspaceUtil.getResourceAssignmentBatchSize();
            asmtGr.chooseWindow(firstRow, firstRow + assignmentBatchSize, true);
        }
		if(!gs.nil(this.excludedWorkTypes))
			asmtGr.addEncodedQuery('operational_work_type=^ORoperational_work_typeNOT IN' + this.excludedWorkTypes);
		else
			asmtGr.addEncodedQuery('operational_work_type=^ORoperational_work_typeISNOTEMPTY');
        asmtGr.query();

        let resourceBoardStatus;

        while (asmtGr.next()) {
            if (this.readAccessCheckEnabled && !asmtGr.canRead())
                continue;
			let raActionHelper = new sn_plng_att_core.ResourceAssignmentActionHelper(asmtGr);
            const taskOrPlanningItemGr = this._getTaskOrPlanningItem(asmtGr, false);
            const row = this.createRowObject(columns, asmtGr, taskOrPlanningItemGr);
            const type = asmtGr.plan_type;
            let isParentnotNil = global.JSUtil.notNil(asmtGr.getValue('parent'));
			const canWrite = raActionHelper.getCanWrite();
            const disableEdit = isTopGrid && !canWrite;
            row._metadata = {
                disableRowReorder: !isTopGrid || (isParentnotNil || disableEdit),
                canReplaceUser: !isParentnotNil,
                disableRowContextMenu: false,
                disableEditing: disableEdit,
                canSplitWork: ((asmtGr.getValue('start_date') != asmtGr.getValue('end_date')) && !(isParentnotNil)),
				canOpenRecord: true,
				canOpenParentRecord: isParentnotNil,
				canExtend: raActionHelper.canExtend(),
				tableName: 'sn_plng_att_core_resource_assignment'
            };
            if (isParentnotNil) {
                row.task.indicator = {
                    icon: "circle-info-outline",
                    "color": "--now-color_text--primary",
                    "tooltip": gs.getMessage("Work is allocated for a team.")
                };
            }
            if (row.resource_status && asmtGr.assignment_modified) {
                row.resource_status.indicator = {
                    icon: "bell-outline",
                    "color": "--now-color_text--primary",
                    "tooltip": gs.getMessage("Assignment details were updated resulting the status change to Pending.")
                };
            }
            this._updateEffort(row, asmtGr);
            if (isTopGrid) {
                this._buildResourceRow(row, true);
                const resourceStatus = asmtGr.getDisplayValue('resource_status');
                if (!resourceBoardStatus) {
                    resourceBoardStatus = resourceStatus;
                } else if (resourceStatus && resourceBoardStatus != this.PENDING_STATE && resourceBoardStatus != resourceStatus) {
                    resourceBoardStatus = this.DISPLAY_PENDING_STATE;
                }
            }
            asmts.push(row);
        }

        return {
            asmts,
            resourceBoardStatus
        };
    },

    getClassicResourcePlanAllocations(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds) {
    	this.getAttributesColumnsOnResourceAssignment();
        const resAllocs = this.getAllocations('resource_allocation', columns, startDate, endDate, empIds);
        const reqAllocs = this.getRequestedAllocations(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds);
        return resAllocs.concat(reqAllocs);
    },

    getRequestedAllocations(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds) {
        let reqAllocsOfOperationalPlan = [];
        const excludeOperationalRPs = this.effortType != 'hours' ? true : false;
        const reqAllocs = this.getAllocations('requested_allocation', columns, startDate, endDate, empIds, excludeOperationalRPs);
        if (excludeOperationalRPs) {
            reqAllocsOfOperationalPlan = this.getOperationalPlanRequestAllocations(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds);
        }
        return reqAllocs.concat(reqAllocsOfOperationalPlan);
    },

    getAllocations(table, columns, startDate, endDate, empIds, excludeOperationalRPs = false) {
        const isReqAlloc = (table == 'requested_allocation') ? true : false;
        const effortField = this._getEffortField(isReqAlloc);
        const allocGr = new GlideAggregate(table);
        allocGr.addQuery('start_date', '<=', endDate);
        allocGr.addQuery('end_date', '>=', startDate);
        allocGr.groupBy('resource_plan');
        if (isReqAlloc) {
            allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.resource_type', '=', 'user');
            allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.state', '2');
            allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.user_resource', 'IN', empIds);
            allocGr.groupBy('resource_plan.user_resource');
            allocGr.groupBy('resource_plan.task');
            if (excludeOperationalRPs)
                allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.plan_type', '!=', this.OPERATIONAL_WORK);
            else {
				if(!gs.nil(this.excludedWorkTypes))
					allocGr.addNullQuery('resource_plan.operational_work_type').addOrCondition('resource_plan.operational_work_type', 'NOT IN', this.excludedWorkTypes);
				else
					allocGr.addEncodedQuery('resource_plan.operational_work_type=^ORresource_plan.operational_work_typeISNOTEMPTY');
			}
        } else {
            allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.resource_type', 'IN', 'user,group,role');
            allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.state', '=', '3');
            allocGr.addQuery('user', 'IN', empIds);
			if(!gs.nil(this.excludedWorkTypes))
				allocGr.addNullQuery('resource_plan.operational_work_type').addOrCondition('resource_plan.operational_work_type', 'NOT IN', this.excludedWorkTypes);
			else
				allocGr.addEncodedQuery('resource_plan.operational_work_type=^ORresource_plan.operational_work_typeISNOTEMPTY');
            allocGr.groupBy('user');
            allocGr.groupBy('task');
        }
        allocGr.addAggregate('SUM', effortField);
        allocGr.query();

        return this._buildAllocationRow(allocGr, columns, effortField, this.ALLOCATION, isReqAlloc);
    },

    getOperationalPlanRequestAllocations(columns, startDate, endDate, empIds) {
        const allocGr = new GlideAggregate('requested_allocation');
        allocGr.addQuery('start_date', '<=', endDate);
        allocGr.addQuery('end_date', '>=', startDate);
        allocGr.groupBy('resource_plan');
        allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.plan_type', this.OPERATIONAL_WORK);
        allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.resource_type', '=', 'user');
        allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.state', '2');
        allocGr.addQuery('resource_plan.user_resource', 'IN', empIds);
        allocGr.groupBy('resource_plan.user_resource');
		if(!gs.nil(this.excludedWorkTypes))
			allocGr.addNullQuery('resource_plan.operational_work_type').addOrCondition('resource_plan.operational_work_type', 'NOT IN', this.excludedWorkTypes);
		else
			allocGr.addEncodedQuery('resource_plan.operational_work_type=^ORresource_plan.operational_work_typeISNOTEMPTY');
        allocGr.addAggregate('SUM', 'requested_hours');
        allocGr.query();

        return this._buildAllocationRow(allocGr, columns, this.effortType, this.OPERATIONAL_WORK, true);
    },

    _buildAllocationRow(gr, columns, effortField, invokedFlow, isReqAlloc) {
        const rowObjs = [];
        let taskOrPlanningItemGr = null;
        while (gr.next()) {
            if (invokedFlow != this.OPERATIONAL_WORK) {
                taskOrPlanningItemGr = this._getTaskOrPlanningItem(gr, isReqAlloc);
                if (this.readAccessCheckEnabled && !taskOrPlanningItemGr.canRead())
                    continue;
            }
            const row = this.createRowObject(columns, gr, taskOrPlanningItemGr);
            row._metadata = {
                disableRowReorder: true,
                canReplaceUser: true,
                disableRowContextMenu: true,
                disableEditing: true,
				canOpenRecord: false
            };
            row.task.indicator = {
                icon: "user-transfer-outline",
                "color": "--now-color_text--primary",
                "tooltip": gs.getMessage("Allocation from Classic Workspace")
            };
            this._populateReferenceValues(row, gr, isReqAlloc);
            this._updateEffort(row, gr, invokedFlow, effortField);
            this._buildResourceRow(row);
            rowObjs.push(row);

            const resId = row.parent;
            let resRowObj = this.resourceMap[resId];
            if (global.JSUtil.notNil(resRowObj)) {
                if (!resRowObj.childTasks)
                    resRowObj.childTasks = [];
                resRowObj['childTasks'].push(row.id);
                this.resourceMap[resId] = resRowObj;
            }
        }

        return rowObjs;
    },

    _buildResourceRow(taskRow, isResourceAssignment) {
        const resId = taskRow.user_resource.value;
        let status = taskRow?.resource_status?.value;
        let resRowObj = this.resourceMap[resId];
        if (resRowObj) {
            if (!resRowObj.resource_status) {
                resRowObj['resource_status'] = {
                    value: taskRow.resource_status.value,
                    displayValue: taskRow.resource_status.displayValue
                };
            } else if (status && resRowObj.resource_status.value != status) {
                resRowObj['resource_status'] = {
                    value: this.PENDING_STATE,
                    displayValue: this.DISPLAY_PENDING_STATE
                };
            }
        } else {
            resRowObj = {
                id: resId,
                task: {
                    ...taskRow.user_resource
                }
            };
            resRowObj['resource_status'] = {
                value: taskRow.resource_status.value,
                displayValue: taskRow.resource_status.displayValue
            };
        }

        if (isResourceAssignment) {
            if (!resRowObj.childTasks)
                resRowObj.childTasks = [];
            resRowObj['childTasks'].push(taskRow.id);
        }
        this.resourceMap[resId] = resRowObj;
    },

    _updateEffort(row, gr, invokedFlow, effortMappingField) {
        let value, displayValue, requestedHours;
        const isFteType = this.effortType == 'fte';
        switch (invokedFlow) {
            case this.ALLOCATION:
                value = gr.getAggregate('SUM', effortMappingField) || '';
                value = !isFteType ? Number(value) : this._getFTEOrManDays(gr, value, row.user_resource.value);
                break;
            case this.OPERATIONAL_WORK:
                requestedHours = gr.getAggregate('SUM', 'requested_hours');
                value = this._getFTEOrManDays(gr, requestedHours, row.user_resource.value);
                break;
            default:
                effortMappingField = this.resAllocEffortFieldMap[this.effortType];
                value = gr.resource_allocation[effortMappingField].toString();
        }
        displayValue = this._formatNumber(global.ResourceManagementUtils.roundOff(value)) + ' ' + this.effortSuffixMap[isFteType ? 'fte' : effortMappingField];
        row['effort'] = {
            value,
            displayValue
        };

        if (row?.user_resource?.value)
            row['parent'] = row.user_resource.value;
    },

    _populateReferenceValues(rowObj, allocGr, isReqAlloc) {
        const isOperationalPlan = rowObj.task.recordSysClassName == this.OPERATIONAL_WORK;
        if (isReqAlloc) {
            rowObj['user_resource'] = {
                value: allocGr.resource_plan.user_resource.toString(),
                displayValue: allocGr.resource_plan.user_resource.getDisplayValue()
            };
            rowObj['task'] = {
                ...rowObj['task'],
                value: allocGr.resource_plan.task.toString(),
                displayValue: allocGr.resource_plan.task.short_description.getDisplayValue(),
                topTask: rowObj?.task?.topTask ? rowObj.task.topTask : allocGr.resource_plan.task.toString()
            };
        } else {
            rowObj['user_resource'] = {
                value: allocGr.getValue('user'),
                displayValue: allocGr.getDisplayValue('user')
            };
        }
        if (isOperationalPlan) {
            rowObj['task'] = {
                ...rowObj['task'],
                value: allocGr.resource_plan.toString(),
                displayValue: allocGr.resource_plan.short_description.getDisplayValue(),
                topTask: allocGr.resource_plan.toString(),
                recordSysClassName: this.RESOURCE_PLAN
            };
        }

        /**
         * For resource allocations id will be userId_asmtId/task/RP id
         * And for operational resource plans we are going to consider row id for mapping
         */
        const taskOrResourcePlanId = rowObj['task'].value || allocGr.getValue('resource_plan');
        rowObj['id'] = rowObj['user_resource'].value + '_' + taskOrResourcePlanId;

    },

    getAttributesColumnsOnResourceAssignment() {
        if(!this.attributeCols)
	   this.attributeCols = new sn_plng_att_core.ResourceAssignmentService().getAttributesColumnsOnResourceAssignment();
    },

    _getDatesFromResourcePlan(aggregateGr) {
        const resourcePlanId = aggregateGr.getValue('resource_plan');
        let dates = this.resourcePlanDateMap[resourcePlanId];
        if (!dates) {
            const startDate = aggregateGr.resource_plan.start_date.toString();
            const endDate = aggregateGr.resource_plan.end_date.toString();
            dates = {
                startDate,
                endDate
            };
            this.resourcePlanDateMap[resourcePlanId] = dates;
        }
        return dates;
    },

    _getFTEOrManDays(gr, hours, userId, date) {
        let fteOrManDays = 0;
        if (hours) {
            const avgDailyFte = global.RMUtil.averageDailyFteForUser(userId);
            let queryStartDate;
            let queryEndDate;
            if (date) {
                const {
                    startDate,
                    endDate
                } = this.getResettedDateValue(date);
                queryStartDate = startDate;
                queryEndDate = endDate;
            } else {
                const {
                    startDate,
                    endDate
                } = this._getDatesFromResourcePlan(gr);
                queryEndDate = endDate;
                queryStartDate = startDate;
            }

            var workingDays = new sn_plng_att_core.AttributeTypeResourcePlanService().getWorkingDays(userId, queryStartDate, queryEndDate);
            const hoursAsPerInterval = global.ResourceManagementUtils.roundOffBasedOnCalendarEventProperty(hours); //rounding off hours based on calendar event duration property
            fteOrManDays = this.effortType == 'fte' ? global.ResourceManagementUtils.hoursToFte(hoursAsPerInterval, avgDailyFte, workingDays, true) : global.ResourceManagementUtils.hoursToManDays(hoursAsPerInterval, avgDailyFte);
        }

        return fteOrManDays;
    },

    createRowObject(columns, gr, taskOrPlanningItemGr) {
        let value = '',
            displayValue = '',
            isProject = false,
            classType = this.OPERATIONAL_WORK;

        if (taskOrPlanningItemGr != null) {
            classType = taskOrPlanningItemGr.getValue('sys_class_name');
            isProject = global.PTGlobalAPI.isProject(classType) || global.PTGlobalAPI.isProjectTask(classType);
        }

        const rowObj = {};
        rowObj['id'] = gr.getValue('sys_id');
        const userId = gr.getValue('user_resource') || gr.getValue('user');
        if (userId) {
            rowObj['user_resource'] = {
                value: userId,
                displayValue: gr.getDisplayValue('user_resource') || gr.getDisplayValue('user')
            };
        }
	
        for (let i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {
            const columnName = columns[i].name;
            if (columnName == 'resource_status' && gr.getValue('resource_status'))
                rowObj['can_edit_resource_status'] = true;
			if(columnName == 'effort')
				rowObj['can_edit_effort'] = true;
            if (columnName == 'type') {
                value = classType;
                displayValue = taskOrPlanningItemGr == null ? gs.getMessage("Operational work") : taskOrPlanningItemGr.getDisplayValue('sys_class_name');
            } else if (columnName == 'parent_item' && isProject) {
                const topTaskGr = this._getProject(taskOrPlanningItemGr);
                value = taskOrPlanningItemGr.getValue('top_task');
                displayValue = topTaskGr.getDisplayValue('short_description');
            } else if (columnName == 'owner' && taskOrPlanningItemGr != null) {
                if (isProject) {
                    const prjGr = this._getProject(taskOrPlanningItemGr);
                    value = prjGr.getValue('project_manager');
                    displayValue = prjGr.getDisplayValue('project_manager');
                } else {
                    const field = RMWorkspaceConstants.DEMAND_TABLES.includes(classType) ? 'demand_manager' : 'assigned_to';
                    value = taskOrPlanningItemGr.getValue(field);
                    displayValue = taskOrPlanningItemGr.getDisplayValue(field);
                }
            } else {
                value = gr.getValue(columnName);
                if (columnName == 'start_date' && global.JSUtil.nil(value)) {
                    value = gr.resource_plan.start_date.toString();
                    displayValue = gr.resource_plan.start_date.getDisplayValue();
                } else if (columnName == 'end_date' && global.JSUtil.nil(value)) {
                    value = gr.resource_plan.end_date.toString();
                    displayValue = gr.resource_plan.end_date.getDisplayValue();
                } else {
                    value = (columnName == 'task' && global.JSUtil.nil(value)) ? gr.getValue('planning_item') : value;
                    displayValue = (columnName == 'task' && taskOrPlanningItemGr != null) ? taskOrPlanningItemGr.getDisplayValue('short_description') : gr.getDisplayValue(columnName);
                    if (global.JSUtil.nil(value) && gr.getValue('plan_type') === this.OPERATIONAL_WORK)
                        [value, displayValue] = this.getTaskValueAndDisplayValue(gr, columnName);
                }
            }

            rowObj[columnName] = {
                value,
                displayValue
            };

            if (columnName == 'task') {
                if (taskOrPlanningItemGr != null && isProject) {
                    rowObj[columnName].recordSysClassName = this._getProject(taskOrPlanningItemGr).getValue('sys_class_name');
                } else {
                    rowObj[columnName].recordSysClassName = gr.getValue('plan_type') == this.OPERATIONAL_WORK ? this.RESOURCE_ASSIGNMENT : classType;
                }
                rowObj[columnName].isClickable = true;
                rowObj[columnName].isProject = isProject;
                rowObj[columnName].isPWSInstalled = GlidePluginManager.isActive('sn_pw');
                rowObj[columnName].topTask = taskOrPlanningItemGr != null && isProject ? taskOrPlanningItemGr.getValue('top_task') : value;
				if(isProject) {
					rowObj[columnName].startDate = {
						value: taskOrPlanningItemGr.getValue("start_date"),
						displayValue: taskOrPlanningItemGr.getDisplayValue("start_date")
					};
					rowObj[columnName].endDate = {
						value: taskOrPlanningItemGr.getValue("end_date"),
						displayValue: taskOrPlanningItemGr.getDisplayValue("end_date")
					};
				}
                if (isProject && rowObj[columnName].isPWSInstalled) {
                    rowObj[columnName].pwsUrl = new sn_pw.BannerContent().getUrlForCheckout('', rowObj[columnName].topTask, rowObj[columnName].recordSysClassName);
                }
            } else if (columnName == 'owner') {
                const {
                    imageSrc,
                    email
                } = this._getUserDetails(value);
                rowObj[columnName]['imageSrc'] = imageSrc;
                rowObj[columnName]['email'] = email;
            } else if (columnName === "ready_for_review" && global.JSUtil.notNil(gr.getValue("ready_for_review"))) {
				rowObj['can_edit_ready_for_review'] = !global.JSUtil.notNil(gr.getValue("parent")); // allow editing only if parent is empty for resource assignments
			} else if(['end_date', 'start_date', ...this.attributeCols].includes(columnName)) {
				rowObj[columnName]['can_edit'] = global.JSUtil.nil(gr.getValue("parent"));
			}
        }

        if (gr.isValidField('resource_allocation')) {
            rowObj['resource_allocation'] = {
                value: gr.getValue('resource_allocation'),
                displayValue: gr.getDisplayValue('resource_allocation')
            };
        }

		//passing parent reference for opening parent assignment from Workspace
		rowObj['parent_assignment'] = {
			value: gr.getValue('parent'),
			displayValue: gr.getDisplayValue('parent')
		};

        return rowObj;
    },

    getTaskValueAndDisplayValue(gr, columnName) {
        let value, displayValue;
        if (columnName === 'task') {
            value = gr.getValue('sys_id');
            displayValue = gr.getValue('number');
        }
        return [value, displayValue];
    },

    _getUserDetails(id) {
        if (!id)
            return {};

        if (this.avatharSrc[id])
            return this.avatharSrc[id];

        const userGr = new GlideRecord('sys_user');
        if (userGr.get('sys_id', id)) {
            this.avatharSrc[id] = {
                imageSrc: userGr.getValue('avatar') ? userGr.getValue('avatar') + '.iix?t=small' : '',
                email: userGr.getValue('email')
            };
        } else
            return {};
        return this.avatharSrc[id];
    },

    _getEffortField(isReqAlloc = false) {
        let effortField = this.effortType;
        if (isReqAlloc)
            effortField = this.effortType == 'hours' || this.effortType == 'fte' ? 'requested_hours' : effortField;
        else
            effortField = this.effortType == 'fte' ? this.resAllocEffortFieldMap["hours"] : this.resAllocEffortFieldMap[this.effortType];

        return effortField;
    },

    _getTaskOrPlanningItem(gr, isTaskOnRP) {
        const tempGr = isTaskOnRP ? gr.resource_plan.getRefRecord() : gr;
        const task = tempGr.getValue('task');

        let taskOrPlanningItemGr = null;
        if (global.JSUtil.notNil(task))
            taskOrPlanningItemGr = tempGr.task.getRefRecord();
        else {
            const planning_item = tempGr.getValue('planning_item');
            if (global.JSUtil.notNil(planning_item))
                taskOrPlanningItemGr = tempGr.planning_item.getRefRecord();
        }

        return taskOrPlanningItemGr;
    },

    _getProject(taskGr) {
        const topTaskId = taskGr.getValue('top_task');
        let topTaskGr = this.topTaskMap[topTaskId];
        if (!topTaskGr) {
            topTaskGr = taskGr.top_task.getRefRecord();
            this.topTaskMap[topTaskId] = topTaskGr;
        }
        return topTaskGr;
    },

    _getEmpProfiles(filerCriteria = '', limit, filterType, filterTable) {
        const emps = [];
        const empGr = RMWorkspaceUtil.getEmpProfilesWithPPSResource(filerCriteria, limit, filterType, filterTable);
        while (empGr.next()) {
            const users = {};
            users['id'] = empGr.getValue('user');
            users['userName'] = empGr.getDisplayValue('user');
            users['primary_resource_group'] = {
                value: empGr.getValue('primary_resource_group'),
                displayValue: empGr.getDisplayValue('primary_resource_group')
            };
            users['primary_resource_role'] = {
                value: empGr.getValue('primary_resource_role'),
                displayValue: empGr.getDisplayValue('primary_resource_role')
            };
            users['primary_resource_skill'] = {
                value: empGr.getValue('primary_resource_skill'),
                displayValue: empGr.getDisplayValue('primary_resource_skill')
            };
            emps.push(users);
        }
        return emps;
    },

    _getResourceRows() {
        return Object.values(this.resourceMap) || [];
    },

    getResettedDateValue(date) {
        const startDate = new GlideDate();
        const endDate = new GlideDate();
        startDate.setValue(date);
        endDate.setValue(date);
        if (this.timeSpan == RMWorkspaceConstants.MONTHLY_TIMEPSAN)
            sn_plng_att_core.PlanningAttributesUtil.resetToMonthStartAndEnd(startDate, endDate);
        else
            sn_plng_att_core.PlanningAttributesUtil.resetToWeekStartAndEnd(startDate, endDate);
        return {
            startDate: startDate.getValue(),
            endDate: endDate.getValue()
        };
    },

    _getDateFromTrendFormat: function(trendDate) {
        let date = new GlideDate();
        let dateDetails = trendDate.split("/");
        if (this.timeSpan == RMWorkspaceConstants.MONTHLY_TIMEPSAN) {
            date.setDayOfMonthUTC(1);
            date.setMonthUTC(dateDetails[0]);
            date.setYearUTC(dateDetails[1]);
        } else {
            date.setMonthUTC(dateDetails[0]);
            date.setDayOfMonthUTC(dateDetails[1]);
            date.setYearUTC(dateDetails[2]);
        }
        return date.getValue();
    },

    _formatNumber: function(num) {
        if (num % 1 != 0) {
            numString = sn_plng_att_core.PlanningAttributesUtil.formatClean(num.toString(), '.');
            return numString.replace('.', this.decimalSeparator);
        }
        return num;
    },

	getChildAndParentAssignmentData(columns, parentId) {
		const asmts = [];
		const asmtIds = [];
		let groupName = '',
			startDate, endDate;
			resourceAsmt = new sn_plng_att_core.ResourceAssignment();

		const assignmentRecords = resourceAsmt.getResourceAssignmentRecords("sys_id=" + parentId + "^ORparent=" + parentId);

		while (assignmentRecords.next()) {
			if (this.readAccessCheckEnabled && !assignmentRecords.canRead()) continue;

			const rowObj = {};
			const id = assignmentRecords.getValue('sys_id');
			asmtIds.push(id);
			rowObj['id'] = id;

			const parent = assignmentRecords.getValue('parent');
			const disableEdit = !parent || !assignmentRecords.canWrite();

			rowObj['_metadata'] = {
				disableEditing: disableEdit,
				disableRowContextMenu: true,
				disableRowReorder: false
			};

			if (parent) rowObj['parent'] = parent;

			for (const { name: columnName } of [...columns, { name: 'resource_allocation' }]) {
				let value = assignmentRecords.getValue(columnName) || '';
				let displayValue = assignmentRecords.getDisplayValue(columnName) || '';

				if (columnName === 'user_resource' && !parent) {
					value = assignmentRecords.getValue('group_resource');
					displayValue = assignmentRecords.getDisplayValue('group_resource');
					groupName = displayValue;
					startDate = assignmentRecords.start_date;
					endDate = assignmentRecords.end_date;
					operationalWorkType = assignmentRecords.getValue('operational_work_type');
				}

				if (columnName == 'resource_status' && assignmentRecords.getValue('resource_status'))
					rowObj['can_edit_resource_status'] = assignmentRecords.resource_status.canWrite();

				rowObj[columnName] = {
					value,
					displayValue
				};
			}

			rowObj['parent_assignment'] = {
				'value' : assignmentRecords.getValue('parent'),
				'displayValue' : assignmentRecords.getDisplayValue('parent')
			};

			asmts.push(rowObj);
		}

        return {
            asmts,
			asmtIds,
            groupName,
			startDate,
			endDate,
			operationalWorkType
        };
    },

    type: 'RMWorkspaceDataFetchSNC'
};]]></script>
